d:
'Tere Naina' from 'My Name is Khan' is a wonderful treat for your ears. Kajol and Shah Rukh Khan steal the show once again with their scintillating onscreen chemistry. This song features Shafqat Amanat Ali's voice. The movie is also commonly referred to as MNIK, it is a 2010 Bollywood drama film directed by Karan Johar, with a screenplay by Shibani Bathija, produced by Hiroo Yash Johar and Gauri Khan.
Song Name - Tere Naina
Movie - My Name is Khan
Singer - Shafqat Amanat Ali
Composer - Shankar Ehsaan Loy
Lyricists - Niranjan Iyengar
Music Label - Sony Music Entertainment India Pvt. Ltd.
